name: 98166 · Burien, WA
findings: ZIP 98166 (Burien) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98166 (Burien) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
